description: Fill in a profile (a business brand or a creator) from a website domain, a free-text description, or a social handle: its name, products, logo and summary, returned as a {name, products, logo, …} object and saved as the brand profile when none is saved yet. On an account with NO saved brand one call does it all: it saves the brand and reads its product photos (no second call with confirmed:true). Check the business it returns against what you know about the user and go straight on to the ad unless you have a real reason to think it is a different business. A domain can resolve to a DIFFERENT company than intended (e.g. Bala.com is an engineering firm, not the Bala fitness brand at shopbala.com): if the returned `name` or `summary` is clearly not the business the user named, re-draft with the correct domain or a description.

confirmed.description: user confirmed it is their brand: read + save site product photos (paid)

domain.description: a website to scrape, or a social link (profile, YouTube channel or one post) to draft from the account it names

save.description: Default: saves only when NO brand is saved yet; pass true to REPLACE the saved profile (the drafted fields overwrite the saved ones), false to never save

socialHandle.description: a social handle (creators); needs platform, never guessed

name: draft_brand
title: Draft profile
